context: Two articles today — 'Israel Blocks Christian Villages' and 'Israel Isolates Christian Villages' — were written from the identical New Lines Magazine URL in the same cycle (both stamped 11:06:05Z), differing only in dateline city and framing. scripts/lib/dedup.js contains no URL matching of any kind (its layers are slug, eventUri, fuzzy slug, and recap title-overlap), so a single source URL entering the selection twice under different headlines is not caught at any stage. This is the same URL-layer gap noted previously and it is now producing visible near-duplicate pairs on the live site, not just theoretical risk. Freshness is computed from only 15 of 61 articles that carry a resolvable publication timestamp, so the 0.2-day median describes a quarter of the day's output.
